desc: Build a league table from match results. Every team that appears in any match (as home or away) gets one row (team, points, goal_difference, goals_for). A win is worth 3 points, a draw 1, a loss 0. goals_for is the total goals the team scored in all its matches; goal_difference is goals_for minus the total goals scored against it. Order rows by points (highest first), then goal difference (highest first), then goals for (highest first), then team name in ascending code-point order (so "B" comes before "a").

decls.ts: type Match = { home: string; away: string; home_goals: number; away_goals: number };
